question: When did the Government of India bring the gender sensitivities of the budgetary allocation in its statement for the first time?
solution:
The correct option is __**2005 - 06.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Government of India brought** gender sensitivities of budgetary allocation** in its statement for the first time in **2005-06.**
 
• This reflects the government's recognition of the importance of gender in budgetary allocation and the need to address** gender inequalities** in the allocation of resources.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Gender budgeting aims to improve **women's access** to public resources and mainstream their concerns in all activities by keeping an eye on spending and public service delivery from a gender viewpoint.
 
• The increased knowledge of **gender sensitivity** has given rise to this phrase.
 
• The **gender budget allocation** for **2019–20 **will be increased from **Rs 121,961 crore to Rs 131,700 crore **per the Finance Minister's proposal.
 
• The Minister advocated for women-led development to become the government's catchphrase in place of** "women's development,"** emphasizing programs for women's** employment, nutrition, and anganwadi.**
